newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE increases retail diesel prices.
newsitem.headline: UAE increases retail diesel prices.

text.p: Diesel pump prices in OPEC-member United Arab Emirates (UAE) rose by more than eight percent because of higher international oil prices, UAE petroleum retailers said on Wednesday.
Diesel increased to 3.9 UAE dirhams ($1.06) a gallon from 3.60 dirhams with effect from December 18.
Retail prices for diesel had increased nearly 35 percent since last December when the pump price for diesel stood at 2.9 dirhams a gallon.
"All three fuel distributors have jacked their prices up by 30 fils. They have done it because international prices are going up," a spokesman at one distributor in the country said.
Retail petrol prices in the Gulf state are unchanged at 3.95 dirhams for a gallon of premium 97 octane petrol and 3.65 dirhams for 90 octane regular gasoline.
